title: The Yellow Mountain
description: Western. Lex Barker and Howard Duff star as prospectors whose friendship is tested when a promising seam of the gold is discovered in a Nevada mountain. With Mala Powers.

title: Deck the Halls
description: Comedy. Neighbours Matthew Broderick and Danny DeVito get extremely competitive as they festoon their houses with increasingly outrageous festive decorations and lights.

title: A Christmas Carol
description: George C Scott stars in Clive Donner's adaptation of Charles Dickens' classic festive fantasy. The miserly curmudgeon Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three ghosts of Christmas.

title: Miracle on 34th Street
description: Festive family drama. Richard Attenborough stars as a department store Santa who insists he's the real Santa Claus. But can he prove it in court.

title: Multiplicity
description: Comedy starring Michael Keaton and Andie MacDowell. Buckling under stresses at work and home, a man decides to clone himself. But he doesn't tell his wife, causing much confusion.

title: The Equalizer 3
description: It's a Robert McCall recall as Denzel Washington tackles the mob in Italy for the 'final chapter' of the ultra-violent vigilante action franchise. Fatti sotto! Antoine Fuqua directs.

title: American Gangster
description: True crime thriller directed by Ridley Scott. An outcast New York cop (Russell Crowe) is charged with bringing down entrepreneurial Harlem drug lord Frank Lucas (Denzel Washington).

title: Hush
description: Thriller with William Ash and Christine Bottomley. A man is drawn into a deadly and gory cat-and-mouse game of survival when his girlfriend is abducted by a mysterious truck driver.

title: Buchanan Rides Alone
description: Western. Randolph Scott stars as a drifter who arrives in a small border town and tangles with a group of villains after helping a wealthy young Mexican, played by Manuel Rojas.

title: Arthur Christmas
description: Aardman CGI animated comedy. When a little girl's Christmas present is forgotten, Santa's son Arthur (voiced by James McAvoy) sets out to deliver it - causing mayhem along the way.

title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
description: Jim Carrey goes green, gross and grinchy in Ron Howard's re-imagining of Dr Seuss's classic. Can cutey Cindy Lou convince the green grump to give Christmas a chance.

title: Home Alone
description: Classic family comedy starring Macaulay Culkin. A boy's parents forget to take him on holiday with them. Then two inept burglars turn up. Can our resourceful young hero outwit them.

title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
description: Family comedy. Macaulay Culkin ends up in a swish New York hotel while his family are in Miami. Nosy-but-kindly concierge Tim Curry keeps an eye on him as the Wet Bandits close in.

title: Angel Has Fallen
description: Action-thriller sequel. Secret agent Mike Banning (Gerard Butler) goes on the run when he's framed for an attack on the President. Can he clear his name.

title: Copshop
description: Action thriller with Gerard Butler. A hitman gets himself arrested so that he can get to a bad guy, who also got himself arrested, so that he could hide from the hitman.
